title: Arcane Assembly Bench
text: Place recipe materials, strike the hammer and collect the result. A manual strike costs 50 base mana, advances progress by 5% or 10%, and has a half-second interval.
The rear shaft accepts automatic drive without player mana. Create requires at least 16 rpm and 256 SU. Without Create, use an own engine, directly or through Spacetime Ports.
The rear face also accepts electricity at 256 FE/second. Electric operation keeps the shaft still and luminous, with current sparks. More power does not speed up forging. Stopping preserves progress.
With Create, a pressing ingredient in the center and empty outer slots also allows pressing recipes to be forged.
